text:
morgan: Idea: build a small delegated-admin onboarding wizard (working name: "ribbon") that sales or platform engs can run when enabling customers. main goals: low-friction demo flow + safe defaults for prod.

felix: +1. ribbon should combine route selection, role presets, and an optional quota slider (tenant-level budget vs per-route). keep defaults conservative.

anya: UX notes: make presets first-class (elevator presets: viewer, invoker, quota-manager). show an "affinity impact" line per route: if you bind this principal, affinity caches warm and we may get 1-3 minute performance improvement for warm paths. show a warning for large fan-out binds.

samir: backend constraints: routing index expects persisted principal->route records for affinity and cache population. temporary tokens ok for demos but must not be used for production routing. we should support two apply modes: token-issue (short-lived) and binding-commit (persistent).

infra-bot: FYI: when bindings change we publish to routing-invalidation-stream. expect ~30s eventual convergence by default. we can do a fast-path invalidation for small diffs.

felix: API sketch: POST /api/v2/ribbon/preview (body: tenant, principals[], routes[], mode={token|bind}, quota_overrides?) returns preview_id + summary array {route, allowed, estimated_tokens_mo, effect: [affinity_warm, cache_invalidation_size], reasons[]}. preview is dry-run.

morgan: Example payload (preview):```json
{
  "tenant":"globex",
  "principals":["svc-ingest@globex","analytics@globex"],
  "routes":["/v1/generate","/v1/embeddings"],
  "mode":"bind",
  "quota_overrides":{"/v1/generate":500000}
}
```

anya: Preview should compute effective policy by merging: role preset -> tenant defaults -> route flags -> org blocklist. return compact conflict codes: POLICY_BLOCK, BILLING_LIMIT, WILDCARD_FORBIDDEN. show these inline.

samir: Security: every commit must create immutable audit records with actor_id, preview_id, human_reason. require org_admin 2FA for persistent binds in prod. cross-tenant binds require approval workflow. forbid wildcard binds by default.

sec: Addendum: preview_id must be stored and referenced in the audit event so support can reproduce the page exactly. retention = 13 months minimum for preview artifacts.

felix: UX: add a small "revert within 48h" affordance after a binding-commit. revert should itself be a binding change and emit its own audit entry. show a visible countdown in the UI.

infra-bot: Implementation note: for binding-commit we will update routing index and emit metrics: routing.binds.applied, routing.binds.invalidation_latency_seconds. Do a canary: route invalidation will be limited to 1% of tenants for first 24h then ramp.

morgan: Rollout plan: ribbon behind org-level feature flag. phases: internal -> pilot (3 customers) -> 25% -> GA. telemetry events: ribbon_open, ribbon_preview, ribbon_preview_result(allowed_count, denied_count), ribbon_commit_start, ribbon_commit_finish(success|fail), ribbon_revert. include tags: mode, preset, has_conflicts, preview_id.

anya: Copy: short helper text for preset: "quota-manager: can assign per-route throughput and budgets. Use sparingly." link to docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/rbac#ribbon

samir: RFC task: I'll open RFC-1720 to propose endpoints (/api/v2/ribbon/preview and /api/v2/ribbon/commit) with sample responses and error codes (409 for conflict, 422 for quota_exceeded). will include backfill plan for routing cache updates and tests for invalidation storms.

morgan: Acceptance criteria: preview latency <500ms for typical payloads, audit record present on commit, 2FA gating enforced for org_admins, no wildcard binds allowed without explicit org exception.

felix: UI mocks incoming from anya. I'll work with infra on fast-path invalidation and with sec on approval matrix.

sec: Filed SEC-821 to track approval matrix and 2FA gating. I'll review RFC once posted.

infra-bot: Note: please add a feature flag check in the client to avoid exposing ribbon to excluded orgs.

morgan: Thanks everyone. action items: samir RFC, anya mocks + copy, sec approval matrix, infra invalidation canary plan. sync next Tue. :thumbsup:
